title: Planning and Strategic Initiatives Committee - June 29, 2026

items.title: Commencement
notes: The Planning and Strategic Initiatives Committee held a meeting this date commencing at 2:00 p.m.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
Public Hearing Matters under the Planning Act (advertised)
notes: This is a formal public meeting to consider applications under the Planning Act. In accordance with the Ontario Planning Act, only the applicant or owner of land affected by the planning applications, a specified person, or a public body, and or the Minister may appeal most decisions.  If you do not make a verbal submission to the Committee or Council, or make a written submission prior to City Council making a decision on the proposal, you may not be entitled to appeal the decision of the City of Kitchener to the Ontario Land Tribunal (OLT), and may not be added as a party to the hearing of an appeal before the OLT. To understand your right of appeal, if any, or for further clarification regarding appeals, please see the Ontario Land Tribunal website.

items.title: Zoning By-law Amendment Application - 1014 Victoria Street North, DSD-2026-253, DSD-2026-253
notes:
The Committee considered Development Services Department report, DSD-2026-253, dated June 4, 2026, recommending approval of the Zoning By-law Amendment Application ZBA25/012/V/ES for Erb and Good Family Funeral Home Limited, for the property municipally addressed as 1014 Victoria Street North. 

E. Schneider, Senior Planner, provided an overview of the staff report. T. Malone-Wright, Manager, Development Approvals, and G. Stevenson, Director, Development and Housing Approvals were in attendance to respond to questions from the Committee.

E. Elliot, MHBC Planning, was in attendance in support of the application and staff recommendation.

It was noted that any recommendation arising from this matter will be considered at the Council meeting later this same date.

motions.item_title: Zoning By-law Amendment Application - 1014 Victoria Street North, DSD-2026-253, DSD-2026-253
motions.text: "That Zoning By-law Amendment Application ZBA25/012/V/ES for Erb & Good Family Funeral Home Limited, for the property municipally addressed as 1014 Victoria Street North be approved in the form shown in the ‘Proposed By-law’ and ‘Map No. 1’ attached to Development Services Department report, DSD-2026-253 as Attachments ‘A1’ and ‘A2’; and, That Council give approval under Section 83(3) of the Funeral, Burial and Cremation Services Act, to establish a Crematorium proposed at 1014 Victoria Street North; and further, That under Section 84(4) of the Funeral, Burial and Cremation Services Act, staff be directed to send a copy of the Council decision to the Provincial registrar and the owner, and that staff also be directed to publish notice of the decision in The Record newspaper."
